Intro: Hey, check me out now! 'Clean' enough for ya? Yeah, can't force me out anymore, huh?!
Wha? Oh, you're new. Sorry 'bout that. Person who used to run this place wouldn't… take too kindly to my being here.
Could treat myself to celebrate the ol' jerk's come-uppance. Ah, what the heck! Hit me with a [DISH].
Success: Gotta be honest, I was lookin' forward to showin' the old guy a thing or two. But… I think this is better!
Fail: I guess I wasn't missing much. You weirdos can keep the rich-people food to yourself.
Reject: And what's YOUR problem with me, then? Go on! I'm listening! Am I not 'classy' enough for you either?
